text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃっはー！
　海にゃ海にゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I hate water, so it's nyot like I'm gonna swim, but I love the beach!
Yakisoba noodles, shaved ice, taiyaki! Beach cafes are a treasure trove of treats!
text_block_list.orig_text:
水は嫌いだから海の中に入る気はにゃいけど、
海は大好きにゃ！
焼きそば、
かき氷、
たい焼き……
海の家にはロマンがあるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about, Tamaki? Only amateurs waste
their finances on tourist traps. On a work trip, we'd have funds
to spend, but a private outing calls for thriftiness!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに言ってるのよタマキさん。
海で散財なんて愚の骨頂よ？
お仕事なら経費が使えるけど、
プライベートは節約節約！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
You're no fun at all, Mifuyu...
Summer's a time to break out of your shell
and let your true desires run free!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミフユはストイック過ぎだにゃ……
この夏は自分の殻を破って、
もっと欲望のままに生きるといいにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.orig_text: 欲望のままって言われても……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki & Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Coming soon: Tamaki and Mifuyu's Desert Island 0-Rupie Life!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次回、
「タマキとミフユの無人島０ルピ生活」

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Oh! In that case, I want to visit bargain sales every day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
それなら私、
毎日バーゲンセールに通いたいわ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll live in a cat-filled paradise,
with more taiyaki than I could ever eat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしは猫に囲まれながら、
たい焼き食べ放題の生活をするのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't that be the purr-fect life?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな暮らし、
あったらいいにゃ～
